headline: Ninja's New Microwave Air Fryer Promises to End Soggy Leftovers Forever
reasoning: This topic scores exceptionally high across the board, combining a new gadget launch from a major consumer brand (Ninja) with a solution to a universally relatable problem—soggy reheated food. It has massive viral potential and mainstream appeal, while also offering clear practical value. The story is a goldmine for diverse formats, including reviews, head-to-head comparisons ('vs. a standard microwave'), and listicles, making it a perfect fit for our audience.
summary: Appliance brand Ninja has launched the 'Crispi Microwave,' a $449 countertop device that combines a microwave with an air fryer. It's designed to first heat food with microwaves and then use superheated air to make it crispy, potentially replacing two separate kitchen gadgets.

source_articles.title: Ninja’s microwave air fryer could be the fix for soggy reheated pizza
